complete_examples.text: By cal-culating through the fractional derivative model, the variation of the equivalent stiffness and the damping ratio with the increasing frequency can be obtained, as shown in Figure 3(c) and (d).

The equivalent stiffness increases gradually as the frequency increases, while the damping ratio increases rapidly when the frequency is lower than 20 Hz, and varies a little when the frequency is higher than 20 Hz.
